t: For purchase, exchange, hire, driving, maintenance, repair, and operation of an automobile for the Speaker, $13,000.

fable.w: This is a plain appropriation for an automobile for the Speaker of the House. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. The only actor mentioned, the Speaker, is inside the federal government.
fable.s: For purchase, exchange, hire, driving, maintenance, repair, and operation of an automobile for the Speaker, $13,000.
